name: Belios Megistus
source:
A masked individual who often attacks Energeia. He is proficient in the use of Ether technology, and uses Mechanical soldiers as well as Warpbeasts as soldiers, wreaking havoc every time he invades. He seems to abhor not only humanity, but anything and everything in this world. Truly, an incarnation of chaos. Who, or what could he possibly be...?

[From the [url=https://ninetail.info/CF/VenusBloodGAIA_International/en18_character.html]official website[/url]]
